            |-- Create run: runId, input, AbortController, generating

                |   |   |-- PiAgentRuntime.createSession() [D4]
                |   |   |   |-- SessionManager.inMemory(cwd)
                |   |   |   |-- AgentContext.toPiMessages()
                |   |   |   |   `-- Append copied history to manager
                |   |   |   `-- createAgentSession({ sessionManager, ...config })

                |   |   `-- session.prompt(renderedEditPrompt)
                |   |       `-- Agent calls submit_diagram_edit(candidate)
                |   |           |-- Validate schema, content and mappings
                |   |           |-- Invalid -> agent corrects and resubmits
                |   |           `-- Valid -> return generated content

                |   `-- revise(baseRevisionId, { kind: replace, input }) [D5]
                |       |-- DiagramRevisionEditor.prepareEdit()
                |       `-- issue(prepared, base)
                |           |-- Preserve diagramId; allocate revisionId
                |           |-- Set parentId = base.id
                |           `-- Register immutable DiagramRevision

                |-- 3. Retain generated revision on run

                `-- 4. DiagramEditService.apply(run)
                    |-- Set status = applying

                    |-- canvas.apply(sessionId, application)

                    |           |-- Check application receipt

                    |           |-- If not already applied: controller.applyUpdate()

                    |           |   |-- Validate and register exact revision
